target: All finite collectibles, exploration records, challenge unlocks, and repeatable activity requirements, spoiler-free

areas.name: Hernand
areas.location_cue: The broad western heartland around the capital, farms, woodland, and mountain roads.
areas.note: Reveal only as much location detail as you need before moving on.

save_backup.title: Back up your save before consuming or upgrading special resources
save_backup.why: A few counters depend on retaining an original item or an unfinished activity window.
save_backup.detail: Keep the backup until every relevant counter visibly completes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins northwest of Spire of Insight.
levels.3: Face the eight bells as a two-row grid and number them 1 through 8 from upper-left to lower-right. Fire at 1 then 2, continue through 3, 4, 5, and 6, then reverse through 4, 3, 2, and 1. The completed melody activates the Cresset.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #3 — Deepfog Basin Everfrost Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins northwest of Calphade Farmhouse.
levels.3: Number the four movable pillars from left to right, using the fixed left pillar as the target height. At the socket controlling pillars 2–4, make four clockwise movements. At the socket controlling pillars 1–3, make three clockwise movements. Finish at the socket linked to pillars 1 and 4 with one clockwise movement; all columns should then align.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins southeast of Warspike Spearmaker.
levels.3: Burn away the vines with Blinding Flash or a brazier-lit arrow. Number the five tall pillars from left to right. Sword-Stab the small controller's socket for pillars 3–5 until those columns sit midway between pillars 1 and 2; use the 2–4 socket until pillars 3 and 4 match pillar 1; then use the 2-and-5 socket until every pillar is level. If the arrangement becomes unclear, leave the region and return to reset it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins southeast of Haunted Hill Hunter's Cabin.
levels.3: Search the graveyard around the sealed tomb and ignite every stone lantern. Once the last lantern is burning, the tomb door opens and the Cresset inside becomes accessible.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Visit the Meandering Hills Ruins in Hernand and inspect the stone-sealed entrance.
levels.3: When normal progression teaches Nature's Grasp here, raise the slab sealing the entrance. Inside, strike the three circular panels with Force Palm in this order: center, left, right. The correct sequence opens access to the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the camp southwest of Duskwood Bandit Camp.
levels.3: Take the loose white stone beside the Cresset and place it in the gap among the standing stones. Adjust it until the formation reads as one straight line of five stones; the completed alignment activates the ruin.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #14 — Precipice of Echoes Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins south of Fort Perwin.
levels.3: Cross the opening tutorial row by walking three tiles forward. On the next grid, link each ordered symbol from the endpoint of the previous one, never jumping to a nonadjacent tile. Use every tile in the final grid without a mistake. The sequence is timed even though no clock is shown; if the plates sink and the door stays closed, restart and move through the planned route more quickly.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #15 — Deepfog Basin Dragon Head Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins west of Thalwynd.
levels.3: Use Sword Stab on the mural blocks to rotate and reposition them. Reassemble the picture so its borders and internal lines join cleanly across every block; the finished image opens the passage behind the dragon statue.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest south of Glenbright Manor.
levels.3: Burn a route through the damaging vines if needed, then face southeast and number the four statues 1–4 from upper-left to lower-right. Turn statue 2 until it faces the center. Turn statue 1 until statue 3 faces inward. Finally turn statue 4 until statues 1 and 4 both face the center; this solves the linked mechanism.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest southwest of Arboria Castle.
levels.3: Sword-Stab each movable fountain pillar and rotate it until both of its spouts aim toward the basin's center. Repeat for every pillar; when all water paths converge inward, the Cresset activates.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river east of Sanctum of Atonement.
levels.3: If Nature's Snare is still unavailable, observe the nearby projection to learn it. Cast the skill on both spinning components and raise each to its upper stop. With both water controls elevated, the flooded area empties and the Cresset activates.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the lower cliff level southeast of St. Halssius's House of Healing.
levels.3: Move the loose pillars away from the circular track before beginning. Sword-Stab the controller and turn clockwise until the first beam indicates the oval mirror. For the second phase, turn a short distance counterclockwise to include Scales, Harp, and Vase. Turn slightly farther counterclockwise for the last phase, enclosing Mirror, Scales, Harp, Vase, and both Horse symbols. The statue door opens after the third correct set.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the castle southeast of Drakesfall Castle.
levels.3: Step onto the western start platform. Advance toward the far statue only while its head is turned away; its blue eyes show when it is watching, and being seen resets your progress. First-person view makes the head movement easier to track. Reach the platform directly before the statue without moving during any watched interval.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #32 — Dragon's Stone Chambers Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the camp southwest of Howling Hill camp.
levels.3: Push the door-shaped center of the mural to enter. Facing the dragon statue, rotate the left disc until its sun is uppermost. Set the middle disc so its C-shaped mark points left and slightly upward. Set the right disc with its outermost spiral at lower-left. When all three match, the wall beneath the statue opens to the Cresset and Memories of Abundance.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #37 — Azure Moon Labyrinth Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the building around Phoniel Ranch.
levels.3: Inside Phoniel Ranch's wooden building, descend the ladder and follow the lower passage. Number each wall's four buttons from left to right. On the wall whose marks resemble F, press 2 and 3; on the wall whose marks resemble P, press 1, 3, and 4. The gate then opens to the Cresset and Memories of Tide.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Hernand bell is inside the clocktower in the northern part of Hernand town.
levels.3: Enter or climb the northern clocktower, use its exterior handholds and interior floors to reach the bell chamber, then interact directly with the bell to ring it and reveal the surrounding map.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: Atop Scholastone Institute, follow the garden path across the plaza to its end pagoda.
levels.3: Reach the mountain-top Scholastone Institute by its road or by climbing the surrounding slopes with aerial Force Palms. Cross the upper plaza, follow the garden path to the pagoda, climb into it, and interact with the bell.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Calphade bell is on the roof of the church in northern Hernand.
levels.3: SAVE-BACKUP WARNING: Calphade temporarily becomes hostile during one progression window and the bell will not register then; ring it before that state begins or return after the area is calm. Climb the church exterior to its roof and interact with the bell.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the pond south of the pond.
levels.3: Immediately west of the Spire of Insight, climb the rock just south of the pond. Use the slightly lower ledge at its northeastern corner, look southeast, and aim at the pattern's lower-left portion until the Black Dragon joins.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest near Spire of Insight.
levels.3: Search the forest near Spire of Insight. Look within the nearby herd for the black horse. Mount it, counter its bucking until the resistance meter fills, then confirm that you want to tame and ride it; extra stamina makes the attempt safer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river around Sunset Valley in Hernand for a conspicuously golden fish.
levels.3: Scan the Sunset Valley river from above until the bright gold body is visible, enter the water, swim directly alongside it, and use the hand-grab prompt. No rod or bait is required. Save before grabbing if you want protection against a rare registration failure.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: After completing the large-wolf optional encounter, search Howling Hollow's cave among the returning wolf pack.
levels.3: Complete the large-wolf optional encounter tied to Hernand's northern gate first. Return to Howling Hollow and look inside the cave for an elite minimap marker among ordinary wolves; if absent, search the surrounding hollow, then leave the region and return to reroll the spawn. Defeat and skin the silver wolf. Its fang can be exchanged at a witch to unlock the mount, and the hunt also awards its helm.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one maze belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the camp northeast of Trovak Camp in northern Hernand.
levels.3: Approach the Ancient Rift from the south. At the first door down-right, use Focused Light only on pillar 3, then press the control inside for an Engraved Stone. At the lower-left three-pillar door, light only pillar 1 and collect the second stone. At the remaining door, strike the far-left and far-right pillars twice each for the third. If an incorrect pillar changes a pattern, leave the region and return to reset it. At the lowest dead end, fit all three stones into the wall sockets.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the fighting pit south of City of Hernand.
levels.3: At the fight pit, open the weapon wheel and equip gloves only before speaking to the host. Win three consecutive unarmed bouts and then the fourth champion bout; any loss resets the streak. The activity remains available after its introductory visit, so an unfinished run is not permanently missed.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point around Scholastone Institute in Hernand.
levels.3: Equip bare fists before talking to the Scholastone host. Only wrestling techniques count; win three consecutive matches, then beat the fourth champion match without leaving the sequence. Clothesline from the blue skill tree deals more damage than basic grapples, and additional Grappling upgrades improve it further. Quitting after a win discards the streak.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point northeast of Lioncrest Manor.
levels.3: Equip an item explicitly classified as a spear or lance in the secondary slot; spear-like cannons and halberds are invalid. Remove armor with automatic damage effects, and do not add elemental effects, because either can forfeit a bout. Turning Slash is allowed. Win three contests consecutively and then the champion match. If you lack a spear, check ordinary enemy drops, camp Lost & Found, and your personal chest.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Look for children playing rock-paper-scissors in a major town such as Hernand.
levels.3: Challenge children marked as environmental points in any major town. A match requires two winning rock-paper-scissors guesses, and each group can be played only once every few in-game days. Save before a match if you want to retry a loss, then accumulate three match wins; they may come from the same group on different days or from groups in separate towns.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Play Duo upstairs in Hernand's inn and at the larger table in Tashkalp; both tables are needed for every opponent-count condition.
levels.3: Win three Duo rounds consecutively and also record wins against one, two, and three opponents. Use the Hernand table and Tashkalp's larger table; a caught cheat or bankrupt player can reduce the latter's opponent count. Compare each visible first stick with the possible totals, fold weak pairs, and press strong pairs with large bets. For a major advantage, earn the Deceiver's Fedora from the trusted arena mineral vendor and wear it to reveal every hand.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Visit the archery contest at Lioncrest Manor in Hernand.
levels.3: Enter as Kliff; the host will not run the archery contest for the other playable characters. Each match is a race to ten single targets. Keep the bow drawn and your reticle near the middle between spawns, sweep only far enough to acquire the next target, and release immediately. Win three matches during one uninterrupted session, then defeat the champion.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point north of Lioncrest Manor.
levels.3: Enter as Damiane; this firearm contest is unavailable to the other playable characters. Be first to shoot ten appearing targets, recentering after every hit so new targets require minimal horizontal movement. Win three consecutive rounds without leaving, then win the champion round. Opponent reaction speed varies, so retry the streak if a rival repeatedly fires at spawn.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use the arm-wrestling table inside the inn at Hernand Castle.
levels.3: Challenge the arm-wrestling table inside Hernand Castle's inn. Complete each input prompt rapidly, win three opponents consecutively, and then defeat the fourth opponent—the champion. A loss breaks the streak and requires starting again at the first opponent.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use the arm-wrestling table inside Calphade's tavern.
levels.3: The Claphade table opens before its champion does. Complete the available Scattered Embers fishing assignment and its subsequent pair of strength-related assignments; after those are finished, return to the tavern. Win three arm-wrestling matches consecutively, then beat the champion in match four.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Complete Hernand's house and town faction work, then take the northern-gate assignment and follow it west toward Howling Hollow.
levels.3: Finish enough Hernand house and settlement quests to unlock the Legendary Wolf group, speak with the soldier at Hernand North Gate, and follow the nearby marker. Clear the surrounding wolves, then block or parry the large target's melee strings. After its first blue bar empties, head west toward Howling Hollow and use the lantern if the trail continues beyond the cave. Win the second encounter for Shadow Claw, an Abyss Artifact, and the item that reveals legendary-animal knowledge.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Advance the Roberts and Alfonso house assignments until the Arboria Castle encounter appears in the Celeste section.
levels.3: Complete the Roberts and Alfonso faction sequences; if the Arboria Castle assignment does not appear, clear the available Serkis one-offs as well. Ignore or safely detonate the small explosive spiders outside and reach the main chamber. Fire attacks knock the wall-climbing target down, creating the safest damage windows; avoid its poison spit and summoned spider clusters. Victory grants Queen's Fans, an Abyss Artifact, and Stirrups of the Open Sky.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Find the sanctum south of the City of Hernand and approach from its eastern Nexus side.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding sanctum request, enter from the eastern Nexus side, and clear the occupation completely. From the interior hall, drop to the lower outside device; the missing pillar piece is just inside the northern doorway on the left. Set it over the broken column and jump-Force-Palm it into place. Back in the hall, break the jar pile to expose the cube, carry it outside with Axiom Force, insert it in the device's eastern socket, then stand in the illuminated square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the cliff around Unicorn Cliff.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the northern Nexus road. Return to that entrance, climb the left stairs, and take the cube from the breach in the wall; use the Kuku Pot if carrying it outside is awkward. Insert it into the device's eastern socket. Burn the foliage covering the small building north of the device, bring out the pillar segment, align it with the northeastern broken column, jump-Force-Palm it into place, and use the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the sanctum around The Ironwood.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the north. Face the rear wall and stairs, climb to the roof, turn left, descend the small eastern stairs and then the stairs immediately right. Pull the pillar segment from the hole on the left, carry it to the northern device, align it over the northern broken column, and secure it with a jumping Force Palm.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Find the sanctum in western Hernand and use the southern road into the site.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the southern road. From the rooftop device, descend the right-hand stairs and light the torch beside the lower door; the pillar segment is immediately left inside. Fit it to the device's northeastern broken column with a jumping Force Palm. At the bottom of the western steps, take the nearest right-hand doorway to find the cube; carry it back, seat it in the device's western socket, and step into the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the sanctum around Stormtalon Ridge.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the occupation from the southern approach. Descend the right staircase, take the first lower doorway on the left, and pull the pillar piece through the ceiling crack with Axiom Force; fit it to the device's northern broken column. Climb the short eastern wall to the roof, collapse the weak section, and seal the cube below into the Kuku Pot. At the north device, discard Reactor Core IV, insert it into the northwestern socket, and use the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the sanctum around Haunted Hill.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request, enter from the east, and clear the sanctum. Pass through both arches; seal the oversized floating pillar piece inside the Kuku Pot. Use the lower opening in the wall to the right, retrieve the cube from the upper-right recess, and carry it to the southwestern device. Insert it into the eastern socket. Discard Fusion Reactor Core LIV-I from the pot, align it over the device's northern broken column, jump-Force-Palm it home, then stand in the lit square.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 1

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection east of Halssius Apothecary.
levels.3: Equip a mask and work between 21:00 and 04:00. A banner immediately left of Hernand town's central Nexus is repeatable: move beyond the soldiers' sight, shoot the hanging pike with an arrow, teleport back to the Nexus to respawn it, and repeat until ten are destroyed without any detection.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 2

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of Torchlight Beacon.
levels.3: Expand Greymane Camp through Grounds of the Sunrise and the ranch-building step in Gathered Will, then complete the ranch tutorial request. Carry goats from the nearby herd to the ranch's middle stall and sell three to Bram. Extra livestock goats obtained elsewhere also count.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 3

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Calphade Beacon.
levels.3: Complete the Greymane wagon-fence introduction in Scattered Embers so Hernand's fence is marked. Steal a wagon, break pursuit, and drive it to that fence for sale; repeat until three wagons have been sold. The introductory delivery counts if performed after the seal was collected.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 6

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Calphade Farmhouse.
levels.3: After collecting the artifact, sell ten stolen pigs to any livestock fence. A repeatable route begins at the pig pen in the field south of Muckroot Ranch: take one pig, leave the suspicion zone, walk it north to the Livestock Black Market, and sell it. Mounting a horse abandons the carried animal, so repeat the route on foot ten times.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 8

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine west of Vellua.
levels.3: Open twenty locked doors using twenty keys; keys are universal, not door-specific. Loot bandits—especially with a fully trusted dog collecting drops—or buy three daily from each Back Alley Shop for 20 copper apiece. Sleep past midnight to refresh shop inventory. Hernand's townhouses and castle provide many nearby locked doors; each successful unlock advances the seal.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection north of Calphade Outpost.
levels.3: SAVE-BACKUP WARNING: the easiest controlled attempt occurs at a fortress defense with siege towers. Reach the southern wall cannon without thinning the enemies, shoot the upper part of the nearest siege tower so its occupants fall together, then fire into the clustered survivors for five simultaneous cannon defeats. Reload if fewer register. The cannons at Fort Windridge in Delesyia are a repeatable but harder fallback.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southwest of Reedfield Graves.
levels.3: Switch Force Palm to its Healing form, then strike friendly combatants with it three times when they need recovery. The healing variant is available from the point Force Palm is learned; change the held skill's mode before using it so ordinary offensive palms do not count.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection south of Sanctum of Penitence.
levels.3: Unequip every weapon and use bare-fist attacks to defeat three enemies within sixty seconds, measured from the first defeat. Gather three weak Hernand bandits close together and soften none of them with equipment or automatic armor effects before beginning the finishing sequence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Glenbright Farm.
levels.3: As Kliff, defeat five enemies with bow damage inside sixty seconds. Marksmanship upgrades, a refined bow, and Charged Shot shorten each kill; soften or group weak enemies before the first defeat because that starts the timer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southeast of Claphade Outpost.
levels.3: As Kliff, defeat seven enemies consecutively with standard arrows only. Poison, explosive, or any other alternate ammunition breaks the condition, so select the basic arrow type before the first kill and do not change it until all seven register. Weak clustered enemies make ammunition and interruption management easier.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Challenges and Changes 1

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection south of the A in HERNAND.
levels.3: Teleport to any restored flying Abyss through the sky-map view, jump over its edge, and accelerate the descent continuously. Touch ordinary ground within thirty seconds of leaving the island. Choose an Abyss over open terrain so cliffs, water, or intervening platforms cannot delay the landing.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Challenges and Changes 3

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Phoniel Ranch.
levels.3: Recruit twenty Greymanes into Howling Hill Camp. Continue the camp faction work through Embers of Return and Gathered Will; the fourth Gathered Will assignment pushes the roster beyond twenty. Only members actually recruited to camp count, not friendly NPCs met elsewhere.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Challenges and Changes 9

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Wild Raiders Camp.
levels.3: Play Duo at Tashkalp's larger table until an opponent cheats. During the draw, a cheater pulls their hand upward toward the throat; a fair draw moves sideways. Enter the blue observation view when prompted and choose Accuse while that animation is occurring. If the tutorial already appeared, watch every opponent's hand manually.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Ruined Chapel.
levels.3: As Damiane, record three defeats with each required firing style: ordinary shots, either Evasive or Focused Evasive shots, and shots fired while airborne. Track the three groups separately. For the aerial set, jump and use Focused Shot to mark weak enemies before releasing during the same airtime; landing before the bullets fire may invalidate that kill.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Sunset Valley.
levels.3: Begin mounted at Sunset Valley and reach Varnia within forty minutes without dismounting; leaving the saddle resets the attempt. A level-5 horse with strong stamina is safest, with Royler offering excellent base speed and endurance. Follow roads, manage sprint reserves, and avoid hostile clusters that can knock you off. A clean route can finish well inside the limit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of THE IRONWOOD text on map.
levels.3: Ride each required breed for at least 100 meters: buy Priden south of Delesyia city; use Camora or a companion's default Brianto; buy Numont in Tommaso; buy Elantrima north of Calphade or in friendly Pailune. Stolen and borrowed horses count, so keeping each mount is unnecessary.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of Karin Quarry Rest Area.
levels.3: Approach living birds closely and hold the interaction prompt to pick them up. Carry five different birds; dropping and recapturing the same individual does not add another count. Calm settlement birds are easier than flocks that immediately take flight.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Sunset Valley.
levels.3: Visit any smithy with the required materials and craft at least one one-handed sword and one bow after the artifact is active. Hernand town's central blacksmith is a convenient choice and appears as an environmental point once discovered. Both crafts are required; purchasing finished weapons does not satisfy the condition.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the seal site north of Hernand Watchtower.
levels.3: Gather thirty weak enemies in a large Hernand encampment and begin the sixty-second window with the first defeat. Use a wide multi-target weapon or secondary heavy weapon rather than single-target sword strings, and pre-position the crowd before killing anyone.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Vilkom Outpost.
levels.3: Arrange three unaware enemies within reach, then assassinate all three within one minute of the first. You can lure them apart, escape detection, and return after they settle. Storm Veil from Wind provides an easier method: cast it inside a group and assassinate coughing enemies before visibility returns.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine west of Roothold.
levels.3: SAVE-BACKUP WARNING: finish this before clearing every One-Eyed Jackal opportunity. Buy the Black Bear's Leather Helm from Pailune's tailor once it enters stock, equip it, and defeat ten One-Eyed Jackals while wearing it. Whispering Forest Dock supplies enough if still hostile; later mixed Black Bear groups and the faction assignment concerning remaining Jackals are fallback spawns. After all such content is cleared, no reliable replacement population is known.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Rapier and Shield 1

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Meshley Trapsmith.
levels.3: As Damiane, defeat five enemies with rapier damage within sixty seconds, beginning from the first defeat. Gather weak targets and soften them with rapier strikes before the timer begins, then finish all five without switching weapons.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection north of Hernand Royal Trading Post.
levels.3: Guard with Kliff's shield, then use Shield Bash to deal the finishing damage to three enemies. Soften targets first with shield bashes or non-damaging setup, and ensure another weapon or passive effect does not claim the kills.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Kharonso.
levels.3: Face one or more archers with Kliff's shield raised and let ten arrows strike the guarded surface. Maintain enough stamina and angle directly toward the shooters; arrows that miss or hit from behind do not count.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Follow the southeastbound road leaving the Sanctum of Benediction.
levels.3: Group three enemies shoulder-to-shoulder, hold guard, and release Shield Bash into the center of the group. Its broad sweep must contact all three from the same bash; a narrow passage helps maintain the formation.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection east of Embernest Beacon.
levels.3: Defeat five enemies consecutively with shield damage while taking no damage. Remove archers first, isolate weak melee opponents, and finish each with Shield Bash. There is no time limit, so reposition safely between kills; any received hit resets the clean sequence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the westbound road from Calphade South Gate, just before the river bridge.
levels.3: Unlock Charge at level 3 of Kliff's Armed Combat branch. While guarding, trigger the double-input sprint and collide with ten different enemies within one minute. Use a large camp and run through a packed line; repeated hits on one target may not advance the total.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection southeast of Calphade Gate.
levels.3: Stand close to a group with a spear equipped and parry incoming attacks. The parry's counter sweep can contact several enemies at once, and each contact advances the total. Accumulate fifteen counterattack hits within thirty seconds.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine around Greymane Nas River Shrine.
levels.3: Enter a dense group with a spear and continuously use its rapid basic poke chain. Keep rotating through nearby targets so attacks never whiff, and accumulate fifty hits within thirty seconds; kills are unnecessary.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Hook Rapids Hearth.
levels.3: Group and soften five weak enemies, then use the spear's Stab attack to finish them within fifteen seconds of the first kill. Every defeat must be credited to Stab rather than ordinary spear attacks or passive effects.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Bradenfern Farm.
levels.3: Despite the displayed wording, the verified condition is five consecutive spear defeats while remaining at full health; enemy weapon types do not matter. Remove ranged attackers first, then isolate weak foes and finish each with a spear without taking any damage. There is no time limit, so recover positioning between enemies without risking the health condition.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Hernand Castle.
levels.3: Equip any sword, group or soften three weak unshielded enemies, then defeat all three within thirty seconds of the first kill. Heavy attacks and weapon refinement shorten the sequence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine south of Spire of Insight.
levels.3: With a one-handed sword equipped, cluster and weaken three enemies, then release a charged Turning Slash so the same wide swing defeats all three. This can be completed alongside the dedicated Turning Slash seal.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection near Goldleaf Tradepost.
levels.3: Defeat three enemies consecutively with sword damage without taking any damage. Isolate weak targets, remove archers and passive offensive gear, and use upgraded heavy attacks. There is no time limit, but any received hit resets the clean chain.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of Kilnden Workshop.
levels.3: Unlock Turning Slash in Kliff's blue skill tree, cluster at least three weak enemies, then fully charge the wide sword swing and release it so the same attack defeats all three. Damage them beforehand if necessary, but avoid killing one early or scattering the group before the charged strike lands.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Pororin.
levels.3: Buy Kliff's blue-tree wrestling skills, such as Clothesline, equip bare hands, and defeat three opponents with wrestling or unarmed skill damage within one minute. Start among weak enemies and ensure weapon or passive effects do not take the finishing blows.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Bloomwood Ranch.
levels.3: Find a long, uninterrupted downhill slope. Sprint to build speed, press crouch to begin sliding, and remain in the same slide for fifty meters without hitting terrain, standing, or transitioning into a fall.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the end of the short road climbing the cliffs from Fort Warspike.
levels.3: Equip a banner pike, obtainable at some friendly camps or from regional Contribution Shops. Double-tap jump to pole-vault and repeat until five vaults register within thirty seconds. Use flat open ground and begin each input as soon as the prior landing finishes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of UNICORN CLIFF text on map.
levels.3: Balance-walk ten meters in one direction along any narrow surface. A rope works, but roof ridges and suitable thin fence tops also count. Step onto a long uninterrupted section, slow your movement enough to maintain balance, and avoid dropping or reversing direction before the distance registers.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Drakesfall Watchtower.
levels.3: Lower Kliff below half health, equip a longsword, group three enemies, and hit all three with one swing. Spinning Slash is the easiest choice because its arc is wide. Remove passive armor effects that might kill a target early, keep health under the threshold until impact, and use weak enemies so the setup remains controllable.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Hernandian Ruins.
levels.3: As Kliff with a longsword, repeatedly use Turning Slash against a dense group. Its broad swing knocks most ordinary enemies backward; register ten knockbacks within thirty seconds, reusing surviving targets if needed.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southeast of Fort Perwin.
levels.3: As Oongka, equip a two-handed club or axe and accumulate thirty enemy contacts within thirty seconds. Rapid ordinary swings work, and sprinting directly into clustered enemies while holding the weapon also registers hits, making a packed camp the easiest setup.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the mountain peak northwest of the Spire of the Stars; the Cresset is at the summit.
levels.3: The easiest approach is to glide from Haven Past the Snowfall, Secret Place #20, toward the peak northwest of the Spire of the Stars. Correct your height with aerial Force Palms, land at the summit, and activate the exposed Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Reach the cliff top southwest of Sunset Valley at Hernand's outer map edge.
levels.3: Approach Sunset Valley from the northeast, climb the cliffs running southwest toward the boundary, and stay on the highest ridge. Use aerial Force Palms where the slope becomes sheer, then activate the Cresset on the topmost ledge.

items.label: Secret Place #8 — Giant Hand of Everfrost

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the mountain northeast of the Sanctum of Benediction, immediately west of the R in HERNAND.
levels.3: Use the R in the HERNAND map label to identify the mountain immediately west of it. Climb from the gentler western or southern face, boost over the final steep shelf, and activate the Cresset on the summit northeast of the Sanctum of Benediction.

items.label: Secret Place #13 — A Hill Guided By Light

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Cresset is atop the hill directly east of Equinsher Saddlery.
levels.3: Climb the hill east of Equinsher Saddlery while avoiding the damaging plants along its sides. More growth surrounds the summit, so circle for a clear landing rather than pushing through it; reach the center and activate the Cresset.

items.label: Secret Place #14 — Guide in the Darkness

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southwest of the Sanctum of Deliverance, use the stone platform that drops into an underground passage.
levels.3: Find the flat stone platform southwest of the Sanctum of Deliverance and step onto its center to descend below ground. Follow the only underground corridor to its far chamber and activate the Cresset there.

items.label: Secret Place #15 — Where Sky Meets Earth

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb to the top of Galepulley, east of the Sanctum of Penitence.
levels.3: Travel east from the Sanctum of Penitence to Galepulley and climb the structure all the way to its highest accessible point. Use a double jump or aerial Force Palm for the final lip, then activate the Cresset at the top.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Follow the coastal cliffs southeast of the Spire of Insight toward the water.
levels.3: Take the cliff chain leading southeast from the Spire of Insight. At the wide gaps, jump, add a Force Palm in midair to gain height, and glide to the next outcrop. Continue seaward to the last reachable ledge and activate its Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: At Anvil Hill beside Wild Raiders Camp, enter through the summit hole or the camp's southern cave.
levels.3: Choose either entrance at Anvil Hill: drop through the opening on the hilltop, or enter the cave in the southern portion of Wild Raiders Camp. Both routes join the same interior; follow it to the recessed Cresset and activate it.

items.label: Secret Place #20 — Haven Past the Snowfall

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: From Kharonso, take the signed route toward the south; stay with it through the western bend to the dead end east of Snowy Plateau Cabin.
levels.3: Start at Kharonso and remain on the marked road as it bends south and then west. At the road's dead end east of Snowy Plateau Cabin, climb the short rise and activate the Cresset. This high point also provides the easiest glide toward Secret Place #1.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the high boundary cliffs southwest of Mountain of Frozen Souls Hearth.
levels.3: Head southwest from Mountain of Frozen Souls Hearth until the terrain rises against the map boundary. Ascend the cliff's stepped side, use aerial Force Palms for the last vertical section, and activate the Cresset on the outermost summit.

items.label: Secret Place #22 — Hill of the Abandoned

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Cresset is on the cliff tops directly south of Mountain of Frozen Souls Hearth.
levels.3: Leave Mountain of Frozen Souls Hearth heading south and stay on the ascending ridge rather than dropping into the low ground. Climb to the highest plateau, locate the Cresset near its edge, and activate it.

items.label: Secret Place #60 — Watcher on the Cliff

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Go northeast of Hoenmark Ruins to the Cresset on the cliff edge.
levels.3: Climb the ridge northeast of Hoenmark Ruins from its inland side, follow the top toward the drop, and activate the Cresset positioned at the cliff's outer edge.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one spire belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the spire around Scholastone Institute.
levels.3: At Scholastone Institute, expose three small cubes by striking the yellow side-room walls with Force Palm, then place all three in the sockets facing the lift. Strike those sockets to raise the four hanging symbols and lower them into this pattern: left symbol at the top; second symbol in the second slot from the top; third symbol at the bottom; right symbol in the third slot from the top. Ride the activated lift, step off promptly, continue upstairs, and enter the gate.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Hernand; one spire belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the mountain around Steel Mountain.
levels.3: At Steel Mountain, clear the approach and burn the entrance growth with Focused Light. Put a nearby pebble in the gate chalice, then place the Gravestone in the lift's chalice. On the next floor add the Telescope and Pen Tip; above that, add the Small Rotating Globe, Celestial, and Sundial from the shelving to the lift's right. The completed offerings carry you to the top gate. A Gold Bar recipe is also on the third-floor right shelving.

areas.name: Demeniss
areas.location_cue: The central territory of plains, temple routes, quarries, and walled settlements.
areas.note: Reveal only as much location detail as you need before moving on.

save_backup.title: Back up your save before consuming or upgrading special resources
save_backup.why: A few counters depend on retaining an original item or an unfinished activity window.
save_backup.detail: Keep the backup until every relevant counter visibly completes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins southeast of Galleypulley.
levels.3: Operate the right crank first because it turns the mural's rear layer; align that background picture before adjusting either metal frame. Use the other two cranks to complete the foreground image, applying Sword Stab to the left control when required. A correct three-layer picture drains the basin and exposes the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins east of Sanctum of Mortification.
levels.3: Cast Nature's Snare on the metal water mechanism and keep turning it until the basin drains. Descend into the exposed area and light every stone lantern; the Cresset activates only after the full set is burning.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #19 — Bamboo Forest Seonangdang Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river south of Sanctum of Revelation.
levels.3: Collect the three loose ribboned stones from both sides of the central cairn. Build the middle stack from largest to smallest in ribbon order: red at the bottom, blue in the middle, yellow on top. If a stone disappears or lands out of reach, travel to another region and return to respawn the set.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest west of Tariv.
levels.3: Gather the movable pots scattered around the clearing and carefully place them on the central base, widest first. Balance a vertical stack of four pots without letting one fall; the fourth successful placement completes the ruin.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest east of Burnhand Quarry.
levels.3: Remove the obstructing branches with Blinding Flash or Focused Light. Facing north, number the statues 1–4 from upper-left to lower-right. Rotate 2 to face the center, operate 1 until 3 faces the center, then operate 4 until both 1 and 4 face inward. The controls rotate linked statues, so judge the result rather than counting turns.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #34 — Secret Chamber of the Golden Plains Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins north of Wheelsmith Wainright.
levels.3: Burn the branches sealing the entrance with Blinding Flash. In the inner chamber, double-jump to catch the grapple point on the left, use it to reach the marked mechanisms, and strike each indicated target with Force Palm. Completing the aerial sequence powers the Cresset.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #35 — The Screaming Vault Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins west of Rustleleaf Farm.
levels.3: Drop through the surface opening and pass the traps to the three side rooms. In the left room, rotate the disc until the short line leaving the inner circle points straight up. In the upper room, put the circles at the top and the triangle tips upward. In the right room, place the constellation's paired lines at the top. All three correct orientations activate the Cresset and grant Memories of Turbulence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: In Demeniss city, climb the capital's tallest clocktower.
levels.3: Climb the tallest clocktower until you reach the flagpole projecting from its side. Hang from the pole so your weight pulls it down and lowers the hidden upper bell mechanism. Climb to the newly accessible top floor and interact with the bell; its icon may not appear beforehand.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint around Stones of Times in northern Demeniss.
levels.3: Burn the thorn growth around Stones of Times, select the local ruins quest, and stand precisely on its X marker. Look high to the southeast; from the exact marker the Shield fragments overlap without additional movement.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint around Demeniss at Sheltering Rocks.
levels.3: Track the ruins quest at Sheltering Rocks and occupy its X marker. Face southeast and look overhead; if the Hammer does not register, walk slightly forward until its lower segment and top diamond lock together.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: At Bowsprit Cape, search the deer herd roaming around the Southern Eldertree for its horned member.
levels.3: Circle the Southern Eldertree at Bowsprit Cape until you find the distinct horned deer traveling with the ordinary herd. Isolate it, defeat it without losing the herd in the vegetation, and skin it to record Vine Deer and receive Aged Branch.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: After the regional hunter assignments open, follow their search marker to northern Demeniss along The Crimson Wall.
levels.3: Complete most Hernand faction work and the constellation assignment at Scholastone, then accept the legendary hunter's tasks outside Lioncrest Manor. Follow the resulting marker to The Crimson Wall in northern Demeniss. Use the lantern to locate and inspect the fallen deer; this draws out the black lion and its pack. Defeat the group, skin the marked lion, collect the Black Lion Earring, and return to the hunter.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point beside Breesman Pasture after Demeniss is liberated.
levels.3: Use a well-leveled horse—Royler at level 4 or higher is especially strong—and fit stamina-regeneration horseshoes. Each match is three laps against one opponent, with catch-up behavior keeping the race close. Maintain a steady pace rather than exhausting the mount early, preserve the inner blue stamina bar for the last corner, and sprint through the finish. Win three races consecutively, then beat the champion.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Find the sanctum north of the City of Demeniss and approach along its eastern road.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the eastern road. From the post-clear ledge, drop north, burn the thorns in the doorway, follow the low passage, and burn the second growth to reach the cube above-right; carry it to the nearby device and insert it from the south. Climb the northern ruin, break through its weak roof, seal the pillar segment behind the northeastern windows into the Kuku Pot, then discard Core XIV-I at the device and fit it to the northwestern broken column. Finish in the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the sanctum around Serpent Marsh.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the south, dodging magical attacks during the final encounter. West of the cleared courtyard, collapse the roof of the isolated building to retrieve the pillar segment; fit it to the device's western broken column. With the device behind you, look east for the cube on the raised ledge, pull it down with Axiom Force, insert it into the northern socket, and use the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river around Denn River.
levels.3: Wait until normal progression gives the restoration objective. Enter the northern building at ground level for the pylon dome, carry it upstairs, align it over the broken pylon, and connect it with a jumping Force Palm. Outside that same northern ruin, burn the wall growth, pull the hidden cube through the grate, and seal it in the Kuku Pot. Back at the reactor, discard Core VIII, insert it into the side socket, and complete the objective.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 9

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the fortress south of entrance.
levels.3: Equip a mask and steal one candle from each of West Demeniss Church, East Demeniss Church, and Demeniss Cathedral. At the western church, use the cupboard candle in the rear-right corner; at the eastern church, use the altar when the room is clear; the cathedral candle is also on its altar. Aim the lantern to reveal the steal prompt, stay outside witnesses' view, and save before each theft if you want to avoid a bounty.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine southeast of Beighen.
levels.3: From more than twenty meters away, defeat five targets in one attack sequence. The safest targets are the fragile mechanical fliers in northwestern or southeastern Delesyia: mark at least five with Focused Shot and release together. Against ordinary enemies, soften the group and use an elemental charged bow shot.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of Silvermoon Tradehouse.
levels.3: As Oongka, unlock Elemental Charged Shot and restore the four required sites: Lightning comes from Courtyard of Precision; Frost from Path of Trials; Flame from Tree of Slumber; Wind from Riddle Square. Defeat three enemies with each Hand Cannon charge type, including unimbued shots. Hold the attack until the muzzle flashes to confirm a full charge; releasing earlier does not count.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Challenges and Changes 4

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the cliff east of Thronbriar Fortress.
levels.3: Complete the full Embers of Return sequence under Greymanes—Grounds of the Sunrise. Follow its recruitment, resource, and housing assignments until the camp-expansion task appears, then finish that construction step to register Howling Hill's second expansion.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Challenges and Changes 7

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use the eastbound route beside the Spire of Clockwork.
levels.3: Win three Duo rounds consecutively at either Hernand inn's upstairs table or Tashkalp's higher-stakes table. Check the opponents' visible first sticks against their possible totals, fold weak hands, and pressure weak opposing draws with larger bets. You may conceal a stick while shuffling, but being caught is risky; the Deceiver's Fedora provides a safer advantage by exposing hands. A lost round resets the streak.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Tariv.
levels.3: As mounted Damiane, hit seven enemies who are themselves riding horses; bear, lizard, and wolf riders do not count. At friendly Thornbriar Fortress, threaten mounted soldiers until they turn hostile and show red minimap dots, then shoot them before they dismount. Progress is cumulative, but doing all seven together limits repeated bounty buildup; clear the resulting bounty afterward.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection southwest of Stonewell Farm.
levels.3: Approach two different wild horses, chase each until the mount prompt appears, and hold the control direction matching its tail movement while it bucks. When the resistance phase ends, choose either to keep it or send it to a stable; both successful tamings count.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northeast of St. Halssius's House of Healing.
levels.3: Remain in the saddle and kill five wild animals within five minutes, preferably with the bow so you never need to dismount. Choose an area with dense deer, boars, or wolves, and begin the timer with the first mounted kill.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection east of Ironwood Farm.
levels.3: Enter a large hostile camp on horseback and keep the horse moving continuously while defeating twenty enemies within five minutes. Mounted melee and ranged attacks both count. Avoid obstacles and heavy attackers that can halt or knock you from the saddle, because either breaks the run.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the junction along the western edge of Springdale Farm's fields.
levels.3: Call your horse below a high ledge, jump and glide over it, then land directly into the saddle instead of using the ground mount prompt. Repeat the aerial mount three times; the same horse and ledge can be reused.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection directly east of the Church of West Demeniss.
levels.3: Ride from Silvermoon Tradehouse southeast of Demeniss city to Vellua on Hernand's southern edge within ten minutes. Use a high-level horse, cut across safe open terrain instead of following every road bend, and approach Vellua without taking cliff drops high enough to force a dismount. Royler's stamina and speed make the margin safer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Burnhand Quarry.
levels.3: Defeat ten Stoneback Crabs, the small Abyss creatures carrying terrain materials on their shells. Search around Abyss structures and bismuth deposits. The cliff deposits near Equinsher Saddlery are an early, repeatable location with several bismuth-backed crabs; leave for a while and return after they respawn until the total reaches ten.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northeast of Southern Court.
levels.3: Catch and carry five separate members of the weasel family. Ordinary weasels and raccoons are confirmed to qualify, and repeats of the same species are fine; the same individual cannot be dropped and reused for extra credit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Thornbriar Guard Post.
levels.3: Buy a broom from a provisioner and upgrade it at a smithy to shorten the fight. Defeat a bear using broom damage exclusively. Remove gear whose Abyss effects retaliate after dodges, and do not mount or perform a cling attack after stunning the animal—either source of extra damage can void the seal. A dependable bear roams west of the Sanctum of Penitence in Hernand.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Burnhand Quarry.
levels.3: Acquire all eighteen mineral records. The three Stone qualities plus Iron, Copper, Silver, Gold, Bismuth, and Scolecite form the first group. You also need Bloodstone through Epidote; add Diamond and Brimstone, then finish with Stalactite, Platinum, and Mercury. Mine unknown deposits, or consume Memory of Ancient Nature from the optional desert encounter to fill gatherables knowledge at once.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the junction west of Demeniss Sentry Camp, north of the Spire of Clockwork.
levels.3: Complete the aquatic Knowledge categories: 25 freshwater fish, 15 saltwater fish, five legendary fish, and 11 underwater wildlife entries. Fish across inland and coastal waters, hand-catch the legendary specimens at their dedicated sites, and collect unknown underwater creatures until all 56 records are present.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Scorchrock Castle.
levels.3: Play as Damiane and defeat one Elite using gun damage only. Identify Elites by the starburst minimap marker at hostile locations or roaming groups. Do not use environmental or armor-triggered damage. Focused Shot can place several marks safely; finish by releasing a fully charged shot so all marks resolve as firearm damage.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Rapier and Shield 2

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: At the GOLDEN PLAINS map lettering, inspect the junction beneath the letter A.
levels.3: As Damiane, use the rapier's Stab input to land ten hits without suffering damage. There is no timer, so isolate one durable opponent or several weak ones, stab only during safe openings, and retreat between attacks without letting any projectile connect.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Rapier and Shield 3

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Ironwood Farmhouse.
levels.3: Knock an enemy fully prone, then strike the grounded body with Damiane's rapier. Repeat until five prone contacts register. Use low-damage knockdowns on durable targets so they survive long enough for multiple floor strikes.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Rapier and Shield 5

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southwest of Spire of Clockwork.
levels.3: Throw Damiane's shield into a dense enemy group and let it ricochet between targets. Additional Shield Toss upgrades increase its bounces, but repeated basic throws also work. Accumulate nine enemy contacts within fifteen seconds.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of the “D” in Demeniss.
levels.3: As Damiane, throw the shield at enemies five times. Every successful toss contact that flips a target advances the counter; one target may be reused if it survives and returns to a hittable state.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Flame Knight's Castle.
levels.3: Jump above a weakened enemy and attack with the spear before landing; the heavy aerial sweep deals the most reliable finishing damage. Repeat until three enemies are defeated by leap attacks within one minute.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Demeniss Barracks.
levels.3: Complete Wind Energy Fusion research at the Great Gate of Urdavah and dispatch to liberated Helmara for Gale Shields. Earn thirty finishing blows with the shield itself. After blocking three hits it can emit a wind wave, but fall damage from knockback does not count; direct Shield Bash finishes on weak Hernand bandits are more reliable. Expect to need several shields.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine northeast of Ironbarrel Armory.
levels.3: Finish Weapon Heat-Treatment research at Zargan Tankworks and send expeditions to the Aeronautical Research Base for Shotgun Shields. Block three attacks to charge the shield, then Shield-Bash at point-blank range to fire its pellet spread. Defeat thirty enemies with shield damage; close weak targets reduce falloff, and multiple shields may be required.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection south of Reventine Monastery.
levels.3: Use only Sword Stab forward thrusts to defeat three enemies consecutively. Upgrade the skill for its follow-up thrust and super-armor bypass, soften each target with Stab itself, and avoid ordinary sword attacks or passive damage between the three kills.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the temple south of Jijeong Temple.
levels.3: Upgrade Kliff's basic heavy Forward Slash, gather five weak enemies, and repeatedly use that tracking heavy attack to finish all five within fifteen seconds. Other sword moves must not claim the finishing blows.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Demeniss; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection south of Demeniss Castle.
levels.3: Visit the four primary witch workshops. The Hernand workshop is in The Witchwoods and opens through normal progression. For Pailune, first help the figure southeast of Wayward Woods, then visit the lake cabin below Silver Wolf Mountain. For Demeniss, assist the figure at the broken bridge west of Deadfire Mountain, then enter the hidden cave-workshop on the Serpent March island. Ride the raised platform, rotate the large glyph disc twice until its route joins left, bottom, and right, then remain on the central platform until it carries you through the roof.

Destroy all three weak points to remove the first bar. For the second, attack the brown pot stack on its back until it breaks.

Teleport away and back to respawn them. Other fallbacks are the mounted pair northwest of Bloodsteel North Gate or provoked riders at cleared Thornbriar Fortress.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Delesyia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.

Keep one of every distinct appearance in the thirty-slot Pets inventory so you can track progress, releasing only confirmed duplicates.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Delesyia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.

levels.2: Climb the mountain summit southeast of the Sanctum of Veneration.
levels.3: Approach the mountain southeast of the Sanctum of Veneration from its stepped western flank. Climb to the highest point, boosting across the final ledges if necessary, and activate the summit Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Delesyia; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southwest of Woodrock Cabin, align the marker with the lower stroke of DEWHAVEN's letter E.
levels.3: Open the map southwest of Woodrock Cabin and align yourself with the lower stroke of the E in DEWHAVEN. Reach the cape at that position, walk to its outer ledge, and activate the Cresset overlooking the water.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Delesyia; one secret place belongs to this region.
