items.label: Ancient Ruin #16 — Five-Finger Mountain Icy Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the mountain west of Cloister of Ruination.
levels.3: Break the ice covering the surface and the frozen side outlet with Turning Slash; clearing both drains the basin. Enter the exposed mechanism and use Sword Stab to rotate the picture blocks until their edges form the complete image, opening the Cresset route.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #17 — Five-Finger Mountain Valley Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the fortress northeast of Whisperleaf Fortress.
levels.3: Push each outer block toward the distant statue to hold its corresponding door open, then shoot the rotating statue visible inside before the door closes. Set the left chamber to the axe, the center chamber to the sword, and the right chamber to the shield. Each correctly oriented figure glows blue; all three together unlock the Cresset.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #26 — Silver Wolf Mountain Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins northwest of Sanctum of Solace.
levels.3: Shatter the ice sealing the mechanism with Turning Slash. Once the machinery is exposed, use Nature's Snare on both rotating assemblies and lift them until the water drains, revealing the completed Cresset.

items.label: Ancient Ruin #33 — Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Ruins

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins southwest of Sanctum of Solace.
levels.3: Enter through the north-wall opening beneath the cliff painting. Inside, activate the four painted elemental panels for wind, lightning, water, and fire. Force Current can trigger them safely from the floor; otherwise climb to each panel and use Force Palm while avoiding the wall spikes. Completing the set opens the Cresset and awards Memories of the Northern Wind.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: Once Pailune town becomes non-hostile, climb the red tower near its central docks.
levels.3: The bell cannot register while Pailune remains hostile, so return after normal progression makes the town friendly. At the docks near the center, climb the red tower to its upper platform and interact directly with the bell.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river southwest of Vat'nholl Fortress near UPPER NAS RIVER.
levels.3: Find the unmarked ring of large stones southwest of Vat'nholl Fortress near Upper Nas River. Stand halfway between the ring's center and its northern stone, then look upward toward the Spire; the Wagon fragments should overlap directly above.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint around Pailune at Swamp of Despair.
levels.3: Stand at the Swamp of Despair's center, slightly northwest of the endpoint of the trade path visible at maximum map zoom. Look southwest and adjust until the fragments form a closed-top numeral 4—the Woodland Spirit Owl alignment.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint around Troll Studying Steles.
levels.3: Begin Troll Studying Steles and continue until it directs you to wear the Constellation Helm. Use the helm at the prompted stele-viewing position and align the Sealed Stone pattern as the objective demonstrates; completing that step records this constellation.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint south of the Spire of Ringing Truth.
levels.3: At the unmarked standing stones on the dead-end trail south of the Spire of Ringing Truth, stand just southeast of the southern stone whose top has a hole. Look straight up toward the Spire and aim slightly below the visible fragments to make the Goblin register. A roaming optional encounter may need clearing first.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the lake south of Snowgrass Hearth.
levels.3: Search the lake south of Snowgrass Hearth. Look within the nearby herd for the white horse. Mount it, counter its bucking until the resistance meter fills, then confirm that you want to tame and ride it; extra stamina makes the attempt safer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Check the pond directly east of Snowgrass Hearth in Pailune for the bright golden fish.
levels.3: Look down into the pond east of Snowgrass Hearth and track the gold-colored fish through the water. Swim close enough for the interaction prompt and catch it by hand; fishing equipment is unnecessary.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search directly south of Frostpierce Cave, west of Pailune's Silver Wolf Mountain area.
levels.3: Approach the snowy ground immediately south of Frostpierce Cave and locate the white bear, using its elite marker if visibility is poor. Defeat and skin it. The claws can be exchanged at a witch for the corresponding mount, and the hunt also awards the White Bear Helm.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search around the P in the PAILUNE map label, between Frost Hill Hearth and Snowgrass Hearth.
levels.3: Sweep the ground centered on the P in PAILUNE between Frost Hill Hearth and Snowgrass Hearth. Find the oversized white bison, defeat it while avoiding its frontal charges, and skin it to register the hunt and obtain White King's Candlestick.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the wild ground directly east of Vat'nholl Fortress for the white elk.
levels.3: Travel due east from Vat'nholl Fortress and scan the herds for the white elk. Close the distance before attacking so it cannot escape into rough terrain, defeat it, and skin the body to complete the entry and receive The Beholder.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the mountains near the eastern map edge, directly east of Pailune city.
levels.3: Climb into the high terrain east of Pailune city near the map boundary and scan for the white moose. Approach from below to limit its escape route, defeat it, and skin it to register the animal and receive Beckoning Forest.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Check beside the road immediately west of the Sanctum of Solace for the snow-white deer.
levels.3: Follow the road west from the Sanctum of Solace and identify the snow-white deer near the verge. Defeat and skin it before it runs into the surrounding slopes. Exchange its antlers at a witch to unlock the mount; the hunt also grants Throne of the White Night.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point around Five-Card in Odeck.
levels.3: At Odeck's Five-Card table, win three rounds consecutively and also record wins against one, two, and three opponents. Compare visible opening cards with possible totals, fold weak hands, and bet strongly with favorable ones. Watch for upward hand movement during a draw, which signals a concealed card; fair players draw sideways.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use the arm-wrestling table inside Pailune's inn.
levels.3: After the Pailune inn opens, continue Tales of the Pailunese Residents commissions until the arm-wrestling commission appears near the south gate. Only one resident task may surface at a time, so check Pailune, Skoghorn, Odeck, and any liberated regional sites after each completion. Turn in that commission, return to the inn, win three consecutive matches, and defeat the champion in the fourth.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Finish the Pailune Militia quest set, then follow the new Skoghorn assignment to Snowhaven Hearth on the western edge.
levels.3: Complete every Pailune Militia assignment, begin the newly opened Skoghorn sequence, and follow its village conversations until the Snowhaven Hearth target appears. Bring fire-imbued attacks: the creature is slow, vulnerable from behind, and especially weak to fire. It has three health bars, so preserve healing resources for the final phase and ignore any temporary outside assistance. Victory grants Frost Hail, an Abyss Artifact, and the encounter-specific earring.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Complete most Pailune Militia assignments, then follow the aerial-hunt marker to the mountain-top Harpy Nest.
levels.3: Complete 24 of the 27 initial Pailune Militia assignments to open the relevant hunt, then climb to Harpy Nest. Dodge the aerial projectiles and dive, striking in melee whenever the target hovers near the platform; arrows work well during stationary airborne pauses. The smaller fliers can be ignored and disappear after the single health bar is depleted. Completion awards Pillar of Wind and Infinite Arrows II.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the mountain around Silver Wolf Mountain.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the north. Beneath the eastern stairs, pull the cube from the caged archway and insert it into the device's northern socket. Return below, break the ice in the northern wall with the pickaxe to drain the chamber, then reach through the opening above for the pillar segment. Fit it to the southeastern broken column with a jumping Force Palm and finish in the lit square.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sanctum belongs to this region.
levels.2: Find the sanctum in central Pailune and enter from its southern road.
levels.3: Accept the corresponding request and clear the sanctum from the southern road. From the bridge to the device, drop south to the lowest floor and enter the crack in the northern wall. Seal the cube behind the spears into the Kuku Pot. The pillar segment is in the alcove just right of that crack; move it up the ledge and fit it to the device's southern broken column. Discard Core XV at the device, insert it into the southern socket, and use the illuminated square on the west.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 4

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Camp Bjornlund.
levels.3: SAVE-BACKUP WARNING: this seal does not credit arrests completed before the artifact is collected, and exhausting every bounty first can make it unobtainable. Take any three bounty notices afterward, track each assignment to its outlaw, crouch nearby, tackle rather than kill the target, and return the captive to the issuing city's constabulary. If a target is absent, revisit during a different time of day.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection east of Camp Bjornlund.
levels.3: Attack five sleeping enemies. The consistent method is to obtain Sleep Arrows from Longleaf expeditions in Pailune, equip them, and shoot five enemies; the sleep-arrow impact itself can count even if it finishes the target. Naturally sleeping nighttime enemies work too but spawn less reliably.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southeast of Beighen Candlery.
levels.3: Remain airborne while hitting three different enemies before landing. Jump and use aerial Force Palm for height, activate Focused Shot, mark three targets, and release during the same airtime. Starting from a high Abyss island and gliding gives a larger window.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Ridgepath Post.
levels.3: Activate Focused Shot, mark five different enemies, and release the queued arrows so each target is hit. The marks need not be placed or resolved simultaneously with a kill; five distinct successful contacts complete the seal.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Ridgehunter Tannery, focusing on the road.
levels.3: Use a horse with Charge and equip a champron; every legendary horse learns Charge at level 2, and Hernand's northern saddlery sells a suitable champron. Weaken tougher foes first, then run straight through enemies to finish thirty with Charge within five minutes. Bleed Bandits around Karin Quarry or Fort Perwin are weak enough for reliable one-pass kills.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine west of Pailune Floodgate.
levels.3: Find Choppies around Abyss structures—the early Axiom Archive route is a reliable starting point—and pick up three separate creatures with the interaction prompt. Repeatedly dropping and lifting one Choppy does not count as three captures.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Skallcove.
levels.3: Learn all three mushroom, twenty-two medicinal-herb, and six poisonous-herb entries by gathering every unknown plant. The faster alternative is to complete the ancient optional encounter in the Crimson Desert and consume its Memory of Ancient Nature, which grants the entire gatherables knowledge set.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of THE ANCIENT RIFT map text.
levels.3: Learn Tough, Lean, Fine, Tender, and Marbled Meat plus Lean Bird Meat, Bird Meat, and Fish Fillet. Inspect butcher stock for several records, skin hunted birds for their meats, and clean a caught fish from the inventory for fillet knowledge. Memory of Ancient Nature is an alternate all-gatherables shortcut.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Check the small wooden shrine at the junction north of Beast Hunter's Camp.
levels.3: Collect all seventy-six insect and arthropod knowledge entries. Whenever a small creature displays an unknown marker, pick it up before leaving the area; revisit regions at different terrain and times for missing varieties. Use the Knowledge category as the authoritative checklist and stop only when all 76 slots are filled.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Whisperleaf Fortess.
levels.3: Enter any 100 of the game's 133 caves. A discovered cave gains a map icon and a completed one gains a checkmark, so use the map to prevent repeats. You may skip 33 caves; hidden entrances commonly sit behind waterfalls, breakable bismuth, or narrow rock openings.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of River Breeze Hearth.
levels.3: Between 21:00 and 04:00, crouch behind an unaware enemy and hold the assassination prompt. Accumulate five nighttime assassinations; they need not occur during the same night. Move between isolated guards so one kill does not alert the next.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: West of Svinholt Ranch, inspect the small wooden roadside shrine.
levels.3: Liberate the Well of Enlightenment and defeat its bismuth-crab encounter to obtain the first Bismuth Spear. Use its ordinary spear moveset for thirty finishing blows. If it breaks, dispatch a Greymane expedition to the liberated Well for another.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Totemfelt.
levels.3: SAVE-BACKUP WARNING: obtain Vessel of Dark Pursuit from the Sanctum of Absolution weapon quest and never sell or discard it; no replacement is known. Equip that sword and use it for one hundred finishing blows. Confirm the challenge is complete before changing or disposing of any unique equipment.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road around Pailune town at a road crossing.
levels.3: Speak with the innkeeper in each of eight towns: Hernand, Calphade, Scholastone, Pailune, Demeniss, Delesyia, Tashkalp, and Varnia. Inns appear as question-mark environmental points after their map area is revealed. Some towns must first become friendly, and Delesyia's residents require the Visione Helmet while access remains restricted. Buying anything is unnecessary; one conversation with every owner completes the seal.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection north of Dewhaven Logging Camp location marker.
levels.3: Unlock the four elements by restoring their sites individually: Lightning at Courtyard of Precision, Frost at Path of Trials, Flame at Tree of Slumber, and Wind at Riddle Square. Buy Imbue Element level 1 in Kliff's red tree. Hit six enemies with ordinary Turning Slash and six with each elemental version, holding the element input during the attack. Track all five sets separately.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the shrine north of Odeck Floodgate.
levels.3: Upgrade Grappling to level 4 for Back Hang. Approach a bear closely, use Back Hang to cling to its back, and remain attached for more than ten seconds. Force Palm can stun the bear and reduce its attempts to throw you. A reliable spawn is just east of the Abyss Nexus west of Hernand's Sanctum of Penitence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road south of Skoghorn.
levels.3: As Oongka, defeat ten enemies with a two-handed axe or club while taking no damage. Work through weak Hernand bandits individually, remove ranged threats first, and take as long as needed; one received hit resets the sequence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection southwest of Torvak Camp.
levels.3: As Oongka, cluster five enemies and launch them together. Quick Swap into the main two-handed weapon produces a wide knockback immediately; alternatively, after unlocking Wind, imbue Quaking Fury so its second slam creates a lifting tornado. All five must leave the ground from the same move.

items.label: Secret Place #2 — Giant Hand of Windy Hills

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Northeast of Skoghorn, enter the middle of the hand-shaped mountain formation.
levels.3: Use the finger-like peaks northeast of Skoghorn as the landmark. Climb between them toward the center of the formation, ascend the inner ledges, and activate the Cresset held in the stone hand's middle.

items.label: Secret Place #5 — Lava Under Snowy Plains

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Northwest of the Sanctum of Solace, enter Dragon's Breath Cave and reach its lava chamber.
levels.3: Find Dragon's Breath Cave northwest of the Sanctum of Solace and follow it into the lava-filled interior. Use the safe rock edges and heat protection or healing as needed, cross to the Cresset platform, and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the cliff directly above and south of the Cloister of Ruination.
levels.3: Begin south of the Cloister of Ruination and take the sloped outer face to the cliff top rather than climbing the wall above the building. Follow the upper rim until directly over the Cloister and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southwest of Volstein Ruins, search beside the E in the SILVER WOLF MOUNTAIN label.
levels.3: Use the E in SILVER WOLF MOUNTAIN as the precise map reference southwest of Volstein Ruins. Climb the tooth-shaped peak beside that letter, reach its upper point, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Cresset is on the mountain ridge northwest of Trovak Camp.
levels.3: Leave Trovak Camp northwest toward the rising ridge, climb along its gentler spine, and remain on the uppermost line until you reach the Cresset. Activate it at the ridge's high point.

items.label: Secret Place #53 — Where the Stars Linger

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Cross the river north of Silver Wolf Mountain Beast Hunter's Camp.
levels.3: Travel north from Silver Wolf Mountain Beast Hunter's Camp, cross the river at the nearest safe point, and climb the opposite bank. The Cresset is on the open ground beyond; approach and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the mountain directly east of Pailune city.
levels.3: Exit Pailune city to the east and begin climbing from the lower mountain shoulder. Use the stepped rock faces to preserve stamina, boost over the last shelf, and activate the Cresset on the summit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Reach the Cresset in the middle of Vannstein Lake north of Pailune city.
levels.3: Travel north from Pailune city to Vannstein Lake and use a boat, swimming, or a glide from high ground to reach the central point. Climb onto the small Cresset platform and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southeast of Pailune city, find the small island in the river.
levels.3: Follow the river southeast from Pailune city until you see the small midstream island. Swim or glide across, climb onto its center, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Pailune; one spire belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the spire around Wayward Woods.
levels.3: Enter through the side doorway and climb to the upper bell. Shoot the wooden support above it so the bell crashes through the floor, then drop through the opening. Defeat the airborne guardian below by using ranged fire to fill its yellow stagger gauge, perform a melee finisher whenever it falls, and repeat. The Bismuth Cannon from Serpent Shrine in southwestern Delesyia is a strong option; healing food and upgraded defenses make the exchange safer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river northeast of Red River Cliff Watchtower.
levels.3: Bring ample arrows, then turn the crank clockwise to lower the barriers across the water. Shoot the three rotating statues until each presents the same helmeted, bearded face shown by the central model. Hits near a statue's outer edge produce larger turns than central hits. Confirm each solution by its glowing eyes, then collect the activated Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one ancient ruin belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins northwest of Hexe Sanctuary.
levels.3: Burn all growth covering the fountain with Blinding Flash or Focused Light. Sword-Stab each revealed pillar and turn it until both outlets point into the middle of the basin. Align every pillar inward to activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: Find the regional bell inside Tashkalp, the major settlement in the Crimson Desert.
levels.3: Enter Tashkalp and follow the settlement's tall central structure upward until you reach its bell. Interact with the bell directly; standing at the tower or settlement marker is not enough to record the Toll of Tommaso.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one bell belongs to this region.
levels.2: Follow the main Crimson Desert roads north to Varnia at the far northeastern map edge.
levels.3: This is a long overland trip: stay on the principal northbound roads through the Crimson Desert until they reach Varnia beyond the northeastern boundary. Enter the settlement, climb to its bell position, and interact with it to reveal the remote section.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the Forgotten City ruins immediately south of the enormous sand hollow.
levels.3: In the Forgotten City ruins south of the enormous sand hollow, find the northern floor slab with a rectangle at its center. Stand on that slab's northeastern corner beside the end of the low broken wall, face southeast, and align the slanted-Z Camel pattern.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one constellation belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the viewpoint east of the Spire of the Sun.
levels.3: At the standing stones east of the Spire of the Sun, position yourself just southeast of the northern stone, aligned with the stone to the southwest. Look due west and aim a little left of the visible fragments to register Giant.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the underground area southeast of Redtree Forest.
levels.3: Search the underground area southeast of Redtree Forest. Look within the nearby herd for the red and black horse. Mount it, counter its bucking until the resistance meter fills, then confirm that you want to tame and ride it; extra stamina makes the attempt safer.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Inspect the pond on the higher ground west of Mistshard Cave for a bright gold fish.
levels.3: Reach the elevated pond west of Mistshard Cave, spot the reflective gold body from the bank, then enter the water and pursue it. Use the close-range hand-grab prompt rather than a fishing rod.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Go to the map-marked blue hollow northeast of Crimson Mountains Fortress; the apparent pond is quicksand.
levels.3: Glide onto the central rock in the quicksand hollow northeast of Crimson Mountains Fortress. Sweep the lantern over the sand until an unknown-interaction prompt reveals the hidden fish's position. Sprint from the rock, grab it by hand as soon as the prompt appears, and continue moving to solid ground before the quicksand pulls you under.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Follow the river north of the Sanctum of Renunciation and check both banks for the unusually pale crocodile pack.
levels.3: Track the large crocodile group along the river north of the Sanctum of Renunciation; it may roam east or west and on either bank. Identify the white-scaled member, separate it from the smaller reptiles if possible, defeat it, and skin it for Pale Predator's Leather Gloves.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the open ground north of Baisun-jahr Camp, east of the Great Gate of Urdavah.
levels.3: Ride north from Baisun-jahr Camp into the grassland east of the Great Gate of Urdavah and identify the white bison among nearby wildlife. Defeat it, then skin the body to register the hunt and receive Lamp of Crossed Dreamers.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the river and both banks around the RED RIVER map lettering for the large red hog.
levels.3: Patrol the river through the RED RIVER label. The red hog may be swimming or walking either bank with smaller hogs, so use the whole nearby stretch rather than one fixed shore. Defeat the large animal, skin it, and collect Chalice of Devouring.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Check the roadside northeast of Varnia Gate for the white lion.
levels.3: Follow the road northeast from Varnia Gate and scan its shoulders for the white lion. Defeat it away from passing hazards, skin the body, and collect the White Lion Necklace to finish the entry.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the forest directly southeast of Serpenthead Valley for the white tiger.
levels.3: Enter the woods southeast of Serpenthead Valley and use the lantern or elite minimap marker to separate the white tiger from the dense foliage. Defeat it, skin the body, and collect the Tigerfang Ring.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one legendary animal belongs to this region.
levels.2: Watch the sky around Merchant's Resting Place, south of the TRADER'S EXPANSE lettering, for a flock circling the nearby Nexus.
levels.3: Fast-travel to the Abyss Nexus near Merchant's Resting Place Cresset and climb its pillar for an unobstructed view. In first person, find the small flock: it loops north along the Nexus's east side and south along its west. Move beneath the distinctive central bird, use Focused Shot to stack marks, and release charged arrows while it remains in range. Defeating it awards Nightmare Burner.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one maze belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the town around town of Burhum in Crimson Desert.
levels.3: Clear Burhum's ranged enemies first if they make the climbs unsafe. In the shorter southeastern tower, enter the opening level with the bridge and Force-Palm the square control for the first Engraved Stone. Cross to the tallest tower; one floor above the bridge, check beneath the covered balcony beside the beds for the second control. Continue upward to the entrance beside the hanging basket for the third. Climb to the roof, drop through its opening, and insert all three stones in the Cresset room.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one maze belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the town around town of Dawnreach in Crimson Desert.
levels.3: Fully upgrade Force Palm so you can deliver three consecutive pushes, and consider clearing Dawnreach first. On the west side, straighten the northern leaning tower from the roof it rests against, enter the newly reachable opening just below, and press the inner control for one Engraved Stone. Straighten the southern leaning tower from its wooden walkway and collect the second stone inside. Move east, push the final leaning tower upright, then insert both stones into the revealed wall sockets to activate the Cresset.

items.label: Maze #4 — Smoking Lands Desert Mouth Maze

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one maze belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins north of Hexe Sanctuary.
levels.3: Use the illuminated ground map as a diagram of every sun-and-moon door in the ruin. Visit each corresponding position and flip the door with Force Palm or Force Current until its map marker lights; leave the already lit southern door unchanged. The easily missed door is below ground at the northwestern edge of the search area—drop through the nearby hole and follow the lower passage until it is overhead. Lighting the complete map activates the maze.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use bare fists to speak with the all-out-duel host in Tashkalp, the southern Crimson Desert town.
levels.3: Switch the weapon wheel to bare fists before approaching the Tashkalp host. Both punches and wrestling techniques are valid in these all-out bouts. Win three matches without a loss, then defeat the champion. Clothesline is particularly effective: use it to floor an opponent and follow with quick punches before they recover.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one activity belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the activity point around swordsmanship contest in Crimson Desert.
levels.3: Complete the arena's two prerequisite all-out assignments to make the swordsmanship host appear on its upper level. The preliminary bouts allow fists and wrestling; the final large opponent cannot be grappled, so parry and answer with heavy attacks. Once the contest opens, use the supplied sword-and-shield rules to win three matches consecutively and then the champion bout.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Read the bounty notice in Tashkalp Town, then follow the marked trail southeast to the Hyena Den.
levels.3: Read Tommaso's bounty notice in Tashkalp Town to open the associated regional quest, then use the lantern to track the target's circling pack southeast of town. Eliminate the smaller hyenas before engaging and carry poison recovery. Empty the blue health bar once, reacquire the trail after the target flees, and defeat it a second time on the same roaming route to receive Putrid Touch and an Abyss Artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one optional encounter belongs to this region.
levels.2: Go directly south of the Well of Enlightenment and enter the giant bismuth-crab clearing; no quest prerequisite is required.
levels.3: This encounter is available immediately at the clearing south of the Well of Enlightenment. Mount the crab and use Turning Slash to destroy its three crystal-covered sections. Crouch to hold on over each exposed white weak point, charge and release a heavy stab, then pull the blade free to register the full hit. Breaking all three removes the first health bar; finish the second by attacking the brown pot stack on its back. The reward includes 30 Bismuth Ore and an Abyss Artifact.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 5

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Crimson Mountains Fortress.
levels.3: Buy and equip a mask from a Back Alley Shop, then pickpocket at least one NPC in Hernand, Demeniss, and Delesyia. Walk closely into a pedestrian and press the brief Pickpocket prompt as it appears, then immediately leave the red search zone. Save before each attempt if you want to avoid retaining a bounty after a failed theft.

items.label: Sealed Abyss Artifact — Above the Law 7

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the ruins south of Desert Ruins.
levels.3: Equip a mask, enter an unoccupied manor or house containing at least five closely grouped steal prompts, and position yourself before starting. Take five separate objects within ten seconds. Large homes around Hernand and Demeniss are reliable; witnesses or time spent escaping between objects will ruin the attempt.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Saltroad Camp.
levels.3: Cluster several enemies or use one large target with multiple hittable parts, then repeatedly use Force Palm. Multiple contacts from one palm count separately, so nine registered hits within five seconds are easiest against a dense group or oversized creature.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Tommaso.
levels.3: Use the three small watchtowers at Northern Pailune Bandit Camp north of Pailune city. Prepare all three, then ignite them rapidly with Guiding Light or bombard them with a cannon so every tower collapses within twenty seconds. They can respawn even after the camp becomes friendly.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Well of Reflection.
levels.3: In the open Crimson Desert, approach a group of vultures on a rock until they take flight, then back away beyond fifteen meters. Use Focused Shot to mark and kill three birds with bow shots from that distance; ordinary ground animals do not count.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the north side of the road at Tommaso's western edge.
levels.3: Use the three small towers at Northern Pailune Bandit Camp. Aim one charged Hand Cannon shot at each of two towers in quick succession, or mark both with Focused Shot and release together, so they collapse within ten seconds. Friendly-state towers return after roughly an in-game week.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Left Eye Watchtower.
levels.3: As Damiane, defeat five enemies with gunfire from beyond thirty meters. Place a map marker on the targets to judge range. The mechanical flying swarms in northwestern or southeastern Delesyia die easily at distance and provide clean sightlines.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection southwest of Sanctum of Renunciation.
levels.3: From more than five meters away, use Focused Shot to mark at least three weak targets and release together so three gun kills occur inside five seconds. Delesyia's mechanical flying swarms are ideal because even an unupgraded gun destroys them in one hit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Saltroad Trading Post.
levels.3: Play as Damiane and use Focused Shot with a pistol. Mark the same target at least three times before releasing; the queued bullets fire almost simultaneously and satisfy the one-second window. Use a durable enemy so the first bullet cannot defeat it before the remaining marked shots land.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Check the southbound route leaving Timeworn Ruins Ironcrawler Station.
levels.3: Tame all three legendary horses: white Royler south of Snowgrass Hearth beside Pailune's lake, black Rokade in the forest near Hernand's Spire of Insight, and red-black Camora underground southeast of Redtree Forest in the Crimson Desert. Approach slowly while crouched, stop whenever the horse reacts, mount when prompted, and counter its bucking direction until the trust sequence succeeds.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Crimson Mountains Ironcrawler Station.
levels.3: Defeat three hyenas during one attempt without traveling more than twenty meters. The Hyena Den southeast of Tashkalp contains a dense pack while its optional hunt remains active. Otherwise check the roads northeast of Crimson Mountains Fortress for groups of two to four; if too few spawn, leave the region and return. Hold your ground and draw the animals into your attack radius.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road east of Cloister of Enlightenment.
levels.3: Defeat three animals from each diet group: three herbivores such as deer, three predators such as wolves, and three omnivores such as foxes, mice, or bears. Duplicate species count, so use common nearby populations and track the three categories separately.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road west of Sanctum of Renunciation.
levels.3: Upgrade Grappling to level 4 for Back Hang, equip a low-damage dagger, and cling to a wolf's back. Perform six dagger stabs without being thrown off. If the wolf dies too early, remove offensive armor bonuses or buy an unupgraded dagger. Do not release the cling between strikes, because the six hits must form one uninterrupted sequence.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of Saltroad Hearth.
levels.3: Four legendary hunts must be skinned: Silver Fang and the White Bear, plus the White-Scaled Crocodile and White Bison. Each has its own Exploration entry and can be hunted only once. Earlier kills are credited retroactively, so collect any remaining skins and confirm all four animal challenges rather than searching for a respawn.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southeast of Duskway Camp Ironcrawler Station.
levels.3: Skin hunted animals until you personally obtain every hide class. The thin, thick, and sturdy varieties are required, together with both short-haired and long-haired hides. Purchases do not satisfy the skinning condition; vary prey size and coat type until every knowledge record appears.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southeast of Well of Patience.
levels.3: Collect five each of normal, fine, and flawless timber. A provisioner-bought Logging Axe yields normal and fine grades from trees. For flawless timber, unlock chainsaw production through the Electricity–Movement Conversion research at Dewhaven Keep, dispatch an expedition to Steelspike Armory, then cut trees with the produced chainsaw. Late-game provisioners such as Timberton may also sell flawless pieces.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northeast of the C.
levels.3: Cook three dishes at ordinary field fires, using the Grilled, Field Grill, or Field Pot categories, then cook three dishes at a fixed special counter under Special Griddle, Special Pot, or Feast. Greymane Camp eventually has a special tool. If recipes are scarce, improvise Grilled Meat Patties with three each of meat, vegetable, fruit, eggs, and cooking oil.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road northwest of Oasis Hearth.
levels.3: Obtain a Propeller Spear through Wind Energy Fusion research and a Helmara expedition, or craft one after Delesyian basic-science research unlocks its blueprint. Equip it secondarily, line up five enemies, and use rapid normal attacks; each thrust sends a wind wave forward, and one wave must touch all five.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northwest of Isvatu Fortress.
levels.3: Obtain a Knuckledrill from the Hernand quarry faction assignment; replacements can later be produced through Electric Tool Design research and a Karin Quarry expedition. Equip it in the secondary slot, hold its basic attack against a durable enemy until the tool overheats and performs its explosive finishing knockback, and repeat until five finishers connect. Brief drill ticks do not count as the required overheat blast.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Arcosa.
levels.3: Complete Dewhaven Keep Facility Research to unlock the Lightning Spear blueprint, then craft one at a smithy; Electric Tool Design also enables Steelspike Armory expeditions for replacements. Equip the spear and earn thirty finishing blows with its normal electric moveset, replacing it if durability expires.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Alabastar Bridge.
levels.3: Speak with every dyehouse keeper; purchases are unnecessary and earlier conversations count. Check three in Hernand—southeast of the castle, Pororin Village, and Calphade—three across southwest, northwest, and eastern Demeniss, one in Pailune town, one outside Delesyia city, one outside Tashkalp, and one in Varnia. The ten conversations collectively teach the seven named dye techniques.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection northeast of Crimson Wall Shrine.
levels.3: Deliver at least one accepted trade stack to each royal market in Hernand, Demeniss, Varnia, and Delesyia after that court's trading opens. Check each castle or city's Details panel for its current weekly demand, buy that cargo into your horse inventory at a Trading Center, and ride through the royal delivery point. Hernand receives goods west of its castle; Demeniss north of its city; Varnia northeast of the central building; Delesyia near the eastern port. Fast-traveling with a loaded horse loses part of the stack but saves time. Demand changes weekly and each court has a purchase cap.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Great Gate of Urdavah.
levels.3: Enter a large unobstructed body of water and sprint-swim continuously in one direction for at least 100 meters. Do not stop, tread water, climb out, or release full-speed movement before registration. If base stamina is insufficient, consume stamina-restoring items while still swimming; using an item does not break the distance chain.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Go directly east of the N in CRIMSON DESERT, near the Ashen Rift map location.
levels.3: Use the N in the CRIMSON DESERT label as a reference, travel due east toward Ashen Rift, and scan the open sand for the Cresset's glow. Reach the low rise holding it and activate it.

items.label: Secret Place #9 — Trial of the Sandscale

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: In Forebearer's Barrens, find the quicksand between the A and R of the map label.
levels.3: Approach the quicksand hollow between the A and R in FOREBEARER'S BARRENS from elevated ground. Do not walk into the sand; glide directly onto the stable center island, correct your landing with aerial Force Palms, and activate the Cresset there.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Visit Verdant Paradise, the small water patch at the Crimson Desert's eastern edge.
levels.3: Follow the eastern map boundary to Verdant Paradise, identifiable as the isolated blue water patch. Enter the oasis, reach the Cresset beside its water, and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: East of the Spire of Clockwork, reach the small island where three river branches meet.
levels.3: Trace the river east of the Spire of Clockwork to its three-way fork. Swim or glide to the small island exactly at the junction, climb onto its center, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the tall cliff southwest of Oasis Hearth.
levels.3: Approach the cliff southwest of Oasis Hearth from its gentler southern side when possible. If climbing from the north, avoid or clear the rockworms first. Reach the flat summit and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Cresset is in Merchant's Resting Place oasis, slightly east of Oasis Hearth.
levels.3: Travel a short distance east from Oasis Hearth into the middle of Merchant's Resting Place. Find the Cresset among the oasis water and vegetation and activate it from the dry central patch.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southwest of Kharati-ram Camp, climb the cliffs between the I and D in CRIMSON DESERT.
levels.3: Use the gap between I and D in the CRIMSON DESERT label to locate the cliffs southwest of Kharati-ram Camp. Ascend from the camp-facing slope, continue to the top plateau, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Immediately west of Hangman's Pass, climb the southern pillar of the large rock formation.
levels.3: Stand west of Hangman's Pass and identify the rock formation's southern vertical pillar. Climb from its lowest joined ledge, use aerial Force Palms for the upper gap, and activate the Cresset on its top.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: At the desert's eastern edge, climb the hill directly above Skin Collector's Hideout.
levels.3: Reach Skin Collector's Hideout near the eastern boundary and circle to the climbable back of the hill above it. Ascend to the summit directly over the hideout and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: South of Duskway Camp Ironcrawler Station, climb the mountain centered in the rainforest.
levels.3: Enter the rainforest south of Duskway Camp Ironcrawler Station and keep the central mountain ahead. Climb its layered rock face to the highest point and activate the Cresset at the summit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: In Forebearer's Barrens, climb the mountain north of BA in the map label.
levels.3: Use the BA in FOREBEARER'S BARRENS to select the mountain immediately north of those letters. Approach from the surrounding high desert, climb to its top, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: North of the FOREBEARER'S BARRENS label, search the ruins east of the enormous quicksand pit.
levels.3: Go directly north of the FOREBEARER'S BARRENS text and remain east of the giant quicksand hollow. Enter the ruined structure there, climb onto its stable central section, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: North of the C in CRIMSON DESERT, reach the stone pillar projecting toward the map-edge water.
levels.3: Use the C in the CRIMSON DESERT label to find the coastal pillar immediately north. Gain height on the inland rocks, glide to the narrow pillar extending over the water, and activate the Cresset on top.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the cliff directly northwest of Howlsands Camp.
levels.3: Travel northwest from Howlsands Camp and climb the nearby cliff to its top. An uncleared local assignment may leave the area inside a visibility-reducing sandstorm; use the map marker and Guiding Light if so, then activate the summit Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the mountain northwest of the Well of Enlightenment.
levels.3: Head northwest from the Well of Enlightenment, take the mountain's stepped southeastern face upward, and use aerial Force Palms across the final shelves. Activate the Cresset on the highest point.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: The Cresset is on the mountain northwest of the Great Gate of Urdavah.
levels.3: Leave the Great Gate of Urdavah heading northwest and climb the prominent mountain from its gate-facing side. Stay on the upper ridge to the summit and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: At the eastern desert, climb the mountain centered among O, S, and E in CRIMSON DESERT.
levels.3: Use the O, S, and E letters in the eastern CRIMSON DESERT map label to triangulate the mountain between them. Climb to its top from the broad western slope and activate the Cresset at the summit.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Crimson Desert; one spire belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the spire around Forebearer's Barrens.
levels.3: Outside the tower, slide the lit mirror toward the middle receiver, move the corner mirror on the illuminated side into its beam, and follow the reflected light across the fixed mirror to the opposite side. Position the next two movable mirrors close together so the beam returns through the center, then align the rear-corner mirror with the final fixed mirror and front crystal. Inside, rotate each stairway mirror in sequence to carry the beam upward; aim the top mirror at the ceiling crystal, take the released stairs and lift, then enter the gate.

areas.name: Varnia
areas.location_cue: The remote route beyond the northeastern desert, reached by following its long main road.
areas.note: Reveal only as much location detail as you need before moving on.

save_backup.title: Back up your save before consuming or upgrading special resources
save_backup.why: A few counters depend on retaining an original item or an unfinished activity window.
save_backup.detail: Keep the backup until every relevant counter visibly completes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection west of Varnia Trading Post.
levels.3: Unlock Meteor Kick at level 5 of Kliff's Unarmed Combat node or learn it from an enemy. Jump or boost airborne, then hold the kick input to slam down. Use tightly packed enemies so each landing records several hits, and accumulate thirty hits within three minutes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road southwest of Varnia Gate.
levels.3: Defeat ten Demeniss soldiers who carry banner pikes within thirty minutes. Farm Southern Court west of Demeniss city by checking the nearby Nexus, killing any banner carriers, then teleporting back to respawn the group; Western and Eastern Court also work while hostile. After liberation, provoke the banner guards around Demeniss Castle and reload the area between kills.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the road north of Varnia Gate.
levels.3: Work between 21:00 and 03:00. Burn a wooden palisade gate completely with Focused Light or fire-imbued attacks until it darkens, then break it using Turning Slash or charged cannon fire. Repeat on a second gate; both need not fall in one night. Friendly Roothold's gate qualifies and respawns after roughly an in-game week, though destroying it may create a bounty.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one sealed artifact belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search the intersection south of Varnia Saltroad Camp.
levels.3: Complete Weapon Heat-Treatment research at Zargan Tankworks, then send a Gorthak Ironworks expedition for a Flamespitter. Equip it in the ranged slot, gather ten enemies into one line, and sweep the continuous flame stream across all of them within fifteen seconds. They need only ignite, not die; stop firing afterward to preserve limited durability.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the cliffs southwest of Varnia Saltroad Camp.
levels.3: Travel southwest from Varnia Saltroad Camp and take the sloped inland face to the cliff top. Follow the upper edge to the Cresset and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: North of Varnia Saltroad Camp, the Cresset is atop the taller of two nearby rock pillars.
levels.3: Climb the shorter pillar north of Varnia Saltroad Camp first, using aerial Force Palms to gain its top. Face the taller neighboring pillar, jump and boost again, glide onto its summit, and activate the Cresset.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Southeast of Sandhaven, reach one of the small offshore islands.
levels.3: Travel southeast from Sandhaven toward the cluster of small islands. Use a boat, swimming, or a glide to reach the island carrying the Cresset, climb its central rise, and activate it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Varnia; one secret place belongs to this region.
levels.2: Climb the boundary cliffs north of Varnia.
levels.3: Leave Varnia heading north to the map-edge cliffs, climb from their inland slope, and stay on the upper rim. Reach the Cresset near the boundary and activate it.

areas.name: Abyss
areas.location_cue: The floating-island spaces reached through restored sky routes and their connected gateways.
areas.note: Reveal only as much location detail as you need before moving on.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: At Ethereal Pathway, move the airborne blue cube onto the right pedestal and leave the other cube on the left pedestal. Drop through the opened center, place the right-wall power cell against its socket, and drive it in with Force Palm. Climb out, reach the center of the large wall cog, strike it with Force Palm, then climb the stairs and collect the floating artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Stand on the first floor plate, then use the lantern to reveal the yellow routes inside the two movable plates. Rotate both with Axiom Force until each yellow route joins its supply wire. Inside the opened tower, pull the front gate, rotate the blue center of the totem until it lights, and follow the formed path. Ride the two moving platforms upward, jump down-right onto the teleport plate, continue to the open garden, and stand on its white-ringed plate.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Abyss sky route, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Cross or glide past the moving platforms and activate the Nexus above the stairs. Crouch on the gold center grate and Force-Palm it to flip into the laser shaft; glide while descending to limit damage. Move the large corner stone beneath the suspended power block, climb up, place that block over the floor socket, and punch it in. Take the teleporter, insert the second block into the right-hand wall socket, then crouch over the nearby button and Force-Palm it to finish.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Cross or glide to the Nexus, then destroy each opening pillar's center sphere with Axiom Force. For the first three pillars, carry the dropped core to its square pedestal, take the flat block from the opened room, and insert that block into the next wall socket. Each socket powers the fan needed to reach the following platform. After the third circuit, ride the activated fans to the restoration button, brace over it, strike it with Force Palm, and climb to the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Wanderer's Way, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Rotate the Skybridge pillar until platforms appear, equip Visione at the memory point, and use its revealed route to reach the teleport light. At Denn River, pull the long block out first; then place the blue cube in the floor socket and Force-Palm it down before returning the long block to its own slot. Climb into the upper mechanism, rotate both the northern and southern corner controls by 90 degrees so all four perimeter squares light, ride the moving chamber to its fragment, exit upward, activate the western Nexus, and Force-Palm the device on the next western island.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Wanderer's Way, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Use the Skybridge north of Origin of Thoughts, then follow the moving, falling, and fan-assisted platforms to Forgotten Altar. Above its Nexus, burn all three thorn patches and place the freed sphere in the container on the upper ledge. Ride the high fan over the central vortex and use Nature's Retribution to halt the spinning mechanism. Drop onto the exposed block, crouch on its top ring, and strike downward with Force Palm; repeat Force Palm on the floor inside to complete the restoration.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Wanderer's Way, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Turn the control southwest of Riddle Square by 90 degrees, then use the raised route and chained fans to reach Origin of Thoughts. From its Nexus, take the left fans to the rings, carry the glowing stone up the broken-ring path, and Force-Palm it into the severed wire. Reach the eastern peninsula, pull the glowing ring control, and rotate all three concentric rings until their breaks form one continuous alignment. Return to the lowest platform and Force-Palm the newly lit center.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Wanderer's Way, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Enter the eastern Skybridge at Forgotten Altar, activate the Nexus, and glide into the opening beneath the pyramid. Repair the right-hand conduit, ride the center lift, and grapple the rightmost lit circle. Through the north door, reconnect the pipe below, climb outside, and fit the blue block from the diamond's underside into the upper spotlight socket. Grapple the middle circle, repair the southern doorway wire, pull the glowing block from the rear wall, reconnect the upper western wire, and fit that block into the southern spotlight. Grapple the final circle, climb into the raised central device, and Force-Palm its center.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Spire of Clockwork, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: At Riddle Square, rotate the central device with Axiom Force until its lighting turns blue. Jump and glide from the center to enter the upward airflow, then pass through the eastern chain of rings before their moving lights extinguish; every ring refreshes stamina. At the final mechanism, climb to its center and strike it with Force Palm.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Before the main chamber, an optional lower moving platform exposes three switches; mark and shoot all three together to disable the lasers and reach the bonus chest. At the Nexus chamber, remove both long blocks from the right room before turning the central cube. Rotate once, put one long block in the left floor slot, and take the flat block revealed there. Rotate back, insert the flat block into the right wall, carry the remaining long block over the cube to the opposite floor slot, then operate the control and collect the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Move the left-wall laser sphere into the center of its square so it strikes the opposite sphere, then drop through the opened floor. Use the left control to display a continuous walkway, stand on the center platform, and place its laser in the third cube; rotate the second cube back to its receiver. Repeat from the right: reveal the walkway, place that laser in the second cube, then rotate the third cube to its receiver. Through the opened door, insert the left power block, press the powered button, and take the teleporter.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: After the second route teleporter and Nexus, grab the control facing the suspended laser cubes. Rotate them into this cross-pattern: left laser to the middle receiver, middle laser to the right receiver, and right laser to the left receiver. When all three spheres are powered, cross the chamber, operate the button, and collect the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Cool the burning block in the pool at the rear and insert it into its socket. The remaining flat block sits left of the far restoration platform behind the laser field. Either rotate the pillar controls while riding the moving platforms, or boost and glide above the beams; move the block forward in stages from each safe platform until it reaches the far side. Place it on the nearby floor receiver, press the restored button, and collect the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Abyss sky route, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: At the first pool, take the left route down the spiral stairs and break the cave's end wall with Turning Slash. Return to the now-drained pool, descend for the power cell, and carry it back upstairs. Insert the cell into the wall socket right of the large cog with Force Current, strike the cog using Force Palm, then collect the artifact from the obelisk on the left.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Reach this route through Ascetic's Rest and the Bowsprit Cape connector. At the rotating floor grid, reflect light from your weapon to expose every plate's hidden channel, then turn the plates until power reaches both the left and right laser lines simultaneously. Pass carefully between the stabilized beams, press the newly powered button inside the forward building, and use the activated floor fan to glide to the structure's top.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Pull the first ground control and follow the timed rings, using each fan to recover height. After ring two, land on the small lit spot of the floating platform and activate its control. Continue through the large rings to the next ground control; take the right fan, then the left fan, then the second left fan to reach the far platform. Ride its vertical fan through the final ring and use the next control. Avoid the laser banks by passing the first on its safe side and circling left around the second. Once the timer ends, use the final fans and control to enter the central tower, rise inside, and strike the restoration button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Abyss sky route, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Crow's Nest has no separate environmental solution. Complete the required encounter at this location when normal progression opens it; the restoration then registers automatically.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Spire of Soaring, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Activate the nearby Nexus before attempting the puzzle, because falling resets the mechanism. Leave the two correctly aimed center spheres alone; climb the right-hand platforms and redirect only the upper-right and far-left spheres onto their wall receivers. Once all four rings turn blue, boost and glide through them to the opposite side. Use Guiding Light to trace and repair the two inactive conduits, one near the middle and one at the far right. Cling to the center of the powered circular wall panel and strike it with Force Palm. Beyond the bridge, rotate the emerging pillar until it glows blue and hold that alignment until activation completes.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Triangle Ring, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Make a manual save at the Nexus before touching the rear-left cube control. From its small floating island, start the laser cube and enter this sequence: Up, Up, Up, Left, Left, Up quickly before the lasers drop, then Up once more after letting them settle. When every orange wall receiver lights, return to the main platform, leap over the large floor cog, and Force-Palm downward onto it. Reload the save if the cube becomes misaligned.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Optional chest: mark all five switches above the first two fans with Focused Shot to stop the airflow, then glide down. For the restoration, use the yellow-pillar platform or glide between the three incomplete rings. Rebuild each by bringing its floating fragments close enough to snap in: the first needs its large and small pieces; the empty western ring needs one large, one medium, and one small piece; the lower-right ring already has its large piece and needs a medium plus a small. After the last piece, do not move during the activation view; then brace before Force-Palming the restored button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Spire of Ringing Truth, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Ride the outer fans and enter the rotating center through its open corner. Rotate the grate control to create an exit, glide upward, raise the holed pillar with Nature's Grasp, then turn the next wall control until another gap opens. Collect the loose core orbiting halfway up—sealing it in the Kuku Pot is safest—and carry it to the top central room. Place it on the empty pedestal beside the existing core, ride the powered wall fan to the restoration button, brace against the airflow, and strike the button with Force Palm.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Below the Nexus, brace on the gold grate and Force-Palm it to flip inside. Remove the flat block from the wall socket, which disables the ceiling barrier; an optional chest sits on the left ledge before you climb out. Carry the block through the ceiling and west to the lower floor socket. Back on the middle platform, aim both powered laser spheres at the receivers directly opposite them, wait for the far-wall button to energize, then cross, strike it, and climb to the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Abyss sky route, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Avoid the buried guardian's attacks until the diamond in its head is exposed and stationary. Grab that diamond with Axiom Force and use Force Current to fill the stagger gauge immediately; arrows also work more slowly. When the diamond falls, attack it at close range for the full damage window and repeat if necessary. After the encounter, climb the central structure, press its upper button, and collect the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Bring cold resistance or healing supplies. Pull the first wall block to remove the barrier, take the flat frozen block through the doorway on the left, and lower it briefly into the lava until it begins emitting power. Lift it back to the upper level and quickly Force-Palm it into the nearby floor socket before it freezes again. If it goes inert, reheat it. Press the powered wall button and climb to the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Outside, aim the ground Lightning Cube at the orange receiver to lower the entrance barrier. Inside, stand on the left plate, drop through the opened floor, and place the first block in the right socket to start the hallway platform. Use the left Lightning Cube on the first receiver to open the side room. There, aim the second cube south on the movable floor and add the core to its pedestal so the cube travels and powers the far receiver. Retrieve both cubes and aim them at the paired wall receivers; Focused Light the receiver inside, move the right-hand block through the new crawl opening, insert it beside the teleporter, return to the first room, and press the restoration button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: At the central stab controls, begin in the slot opposite the entrance and rotate clockwise until the three pillars on the left light just above ground level. Move one slot clockwise and rotate clockwise until the left pillar reaches ground level. Move one more slot clockwise, then rotate counterclockwise until every pillar aligns with the ground rings and turns blue. Activate the far button from a distance with Axiom Force and Force Current so the surrounding lava cannot reset the arrangement.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Sleet Isles, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Take the block immediately below the Nexus and place it in the socket beneath to start the first ring. Travel against its rotation to the airborne second block, carry that block to the side tower, and use it in the tower's floor socket to remove the barrier around a third block. Take the third block out, retrieve the second from the socket, and bring both upward. Use one to start the second ring, carry the other along that ring to the highest ring, insert it in the final floor socket, then brace while striking the activated button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Place both floating outer cores on the pedestals beside the entrance. Shoot the two yellow wall switches quickly, raise the unlocked wall with Nature's Grasp, then mark and shoot all four switches inside to disable the lasers and central barrier. Take the Golden Sword before the platform descends. In the lower laser hall, carry the flat block to the far wall socket to start the teleporter. Above, insert the next block into the right socket and press the restored button. A bonus chest is behind burnable vines near the final artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Spire of the Stars, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Activate the entry floor plate, then use three consecutive midair Force Palms to reach the first tall pillar. Recharge Spirit, repeat the triple boost toward the large main platform, and land beside its yellow floor mechanism. Jump directly over that mechanism and strike downward with Force Palm to complete the restoration.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Optional chest: below-right of the opening route, place loose Abyss fragments beside the doorway to interrupt its lasers. For the restoration, circle right from the visible button and descend to the chiming room. Number the five targets left-to-right, then Focused-Light the rightmost; leftmost; second; middle; fourth; rightmost; and finally the leftmost twice. Return one room, boost through the ceiling, climb the rocky right side, and put the floating block into the empty socket beside the installed block. Exit left, repair the conduit on the ground beside the button, then press it.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Use the falling platforms and round lift to reach the Nexus. Put the airborne flat block into the left plate, then move the core onto the center pedestal and slip below while that plate flips. Pull the first underground block through the cracked wall, feed it through the side opening and vertical shaft, teleport up, and retrieve it from the left floor hole. Arrange the blocks in the middle and both right sockets, cycle the core to flip the right plate, and enter the newly accessible far room below. Send its block through the wall passage and right shaft, return above, retrieve it, and fill the remaining left sockets; move the middle block left as well. The mechanism activates when all four plate sockets are occupied.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Bring a generous arrow supply and the upgraded Focus Shot; ordinary shots cannot reliably clear the moving sets. At the Nexus, mark and release on the two yellow diamond faces ahead, then proceed counterclockwise and repeat on the groups of three and four. Only the flat yellow faces count. Ride the central fan once those ground groups are lit, then activate all three diamonds inside each airborne ring. You can stand on the rim beside the upper set and wait for its faces to rotate into view if shooting while gliding proves awkward. Activating both aerial groups powers the restoration button and grants Lightning.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Retrieve the flat block from the lower-right platform by lowering the large block into climbing range, then carry it to the empty socket beneath the left laser and seat it with Force Palm. Rotate that laser toward the upper-right floating reflector until its beam reaches the matching sphere across the room. Adjust the already powered right laser toward the reflector above it, aiming near the reflector's left edge. When both far spheres illuminate, use the doorway and fan between them to reach the exterior. Repair the ground conduit behind your landing point, then strike the powered restoration button with Force Palm.

levels.2: Search inside Spire of the Sun, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: This restoration has no environmental puzzle. Complete the mandatory combat encounter that normal progression brings to Nest of Valor; the location registers as restored as soon as that encounter ends.
