levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Follow or glide past the unfolding approach to the Nexus, then use a charged Focused Force Palm on the central sphere embedded in the bismuth wall. Inside, break the two additional bismuth barriers: one high-left and one low-right. Take the flat power cell from behind the right barrier and insert it into the floor socket beside the walkway. The powered control is behind the former left barrier; press it, then collect the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Ride either moving gate across from Nest of Valor and drop through the floor opening. First rotate the three circular wall plates on the right until Guiding Light shows an unbroken powered route. In the button chamber, cling to the protruding button, hold Resist so its recoil cannot throw you down, and use Force Palm. Each strike changes which button protrudes; keep striking the raised one and use Guiding Light between attempts until every line and button is blue. Repair the broken conduit where the completed route ends to finish the restoration.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Dry Valley, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: At the central stairs, flip the first wall plate so power runs left. Climb the right wall into the side room and flip its right-hand plate to energize that section. At the structure's top, use the floor grate to enter the southern room, turn the inner grate so its horizontal channel faces the opposite side, and descend to the power block. Guide the block through the bars and small cell opening, flip yourself outside with the grate, then recover it. Carry it upstairs and place it beside the button together with the loose block already floating there. Press the button and climb for the artifact.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside The Path of Providence, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Pass the opening waterfall with a charged Stab or climb around it. At the first laser grate, cling while the beam rises, hold Resist, and Force-Palm the grate to flip through; repeat at the upper grate to enter the first block room. Hold that flat block horizontally, slide it into an upper side slot, exit, climb above it, turn it vertical, and lower it through the narrow opening into the nearby socket. For the second block, cross the southern waterfall, grab it through the wall gap, push it out through the opposite hole, then follow the outer branches upward to recover it. Insert it beside the spinning wheels, climb above, and press the newly powered button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Search inside Spire of Insight, focusing on the sky route.
levels.3: Raise the first wall with Nature's Grasp and burn the thorn growth throughout the chamber with Focused Light. Take the burning flat block from the middle-right platform, dip it in the pool on the left, and place the cooled block in the socket near the entrance. Across the chamber, burn the vines left of the restoration control and raise the revealed wall. Put the second flat block into the socket inside, lift that wall again, and wedge an Abyss fragment beneath it so it cannot close and break the circuit. Climb out and press the powered button.

levels.1: Keep exploring within Abyss; one restoration belongs to this region.
levels.2: Use the terminal Skybridge Gate reached after restoring the other Abyss branches.
levels.3: Complete the other Abyss restorations first, then revisit the terminal Skybridge Gate on each branch when its central passage becomes usable. Enter Dimensional Bonds from Precipice of Truth, Twisted Thicketway, Crescent Skybridge, Crossroads of Uncertainty, Ether Fragment, Nest of Valor, and Cradle of Truth. The Insight, Ringing Truth, Clockwork, Sun, and Frost controls sit directly along their short paths; Soaring's control is east on the main platform, while Jijeong Temple's is across the left gap after the approach. Activate all seven pulses, checking the Dimensional Bonds objective marks if one remains incomplete.
